about: Metrics plant-watch knows how to place, shop floor first, then orders, shipping, budget, forecast and the working calendar. stage keys come from value_streams.json. synonyms are lower-case words matched against column headers, report labels and Notes lines; a label takes the first metric that matches, so more specific metrics come before general ones.

downtime.label: Downtime
downtime.question: Which stops count as downtime: should changeovers and planned maintenance count?

good.label: Good output
good.question: Which system is the record for good output, and when is a part counted as good?

scrap.label: Scrap
scrap.question: Does scrap include parts pulled for rework, and which system is the record?

planned.label: Planned quantity
planned.question: Is the plan per shift or per job, and which version of the schedule counts?

availability.label: Availability
availability.question: What is planned production time, and which stops come out of it?

planned_minutes.label: Planned production time
planned_minutes.question: How many minutes per shift are planned production time?

job_key.label: Job / work order number
job_key.question: What is the one format for a work order number, and who fixes mistyped ones?

budget_attainment.label: % to budget
budget_attainment.question: Which actual is compared with which budget, over what period (month, quarter or year to date)?

order_target.label: Order target
order_target.question: Where does the order target come from (budget, forecast or a set number), and how is it spread over days and weeks?

orders.label: Orders booked
orders.question: When does an order count as booked, and how are changes and cancellations counted?

shipments.label: Shipped
shipments.question: When does a shipment count (picked, packed, left the dock, invoiced), and in which period?

forecast.label: Forecast
forecast.question: Which forecast is current, who updates it, and does it replace the budget for targets?

budget.label: Budget
budget.question: Which budget is the one targets and attainment are measured against?

working_days.label: Working days
working_days.question: How many working days does a month and a year have, and do holidays and shutdowns come out?

performance.label: Performance / utilization
performance.question: What is divided by what: run hours by available hours, or by planned hours, and is maintenance taken out?

capacity_hours.label: Capacity hours
capacity_hours.question: Which hours count (run, standard, labor or available), and how long is a shift and a day?
